'''Heptooinians''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="TLJ" /> that originated from the [[Heptooine system]].<ref name="Appendix" /> [[Kaljach Sonmi]]<ref name="The Ride" /> and [[Haki Zeophrine]]<ref name="Mof" /> were members of this species.

Heptooinians had a humanoid posture, [[Color|gray]] skin and flat [[nose]]less faces with long [[ear]]s.<ref name="TLJ" /> They had an organ at their neck that could store half an [[Standard hour|hour]] worth of [[oxygen]]. It was a vestigial organ left over from a [[Heptooinian precursor species|precursor species]] of the Heptooinians and as such was often removed during childhood.<ref name="Mof" />
